interpretation: Scenario-selection preference for the Whittaker fit, not a physical law. Penalize outside land on the full source terrain, including unpainted cells. Keep the original envelopes and classifier unchanged.
objective: Strict target-to-biome score minus 2*max(source-land outside share - 0.01, 0) minus 0.1*mean_land(min(scaled envelope distance,4)^2). Distance uses the existing 5 C / 500 mm axis scales. Invalid land climates receive the maximum distance debt.
